The two models are effectively tied on relevant capability (Extraction/Retrieval and overall benchmarks within variance), so I broke the tie using self-reported task preference — Avocet favors well-specified tasks with clear completion criteria, which matches this exactly, whereas Whimbrel reports no strong preference here. Routing to the model that prefers the task type costs nothing on quality and respects its stated preferences.
